subject.title: fix(ui): new sessions remember valid workspace and model choices

question: Should the Control UI permanently remember each browser user’s New Session workspace, worktree, model, and reasoning selections per Gateway and agent?
rationale: This is a new persisted user-preference contract, not a correction to a documented existing persistence contract, and the linked issue plus this PR retain explicit maintainer/product-decision signals.

options.title: Sponsor browser-local persistence
options.body: Accept this per-browser, per-Gateway, per-agent preference behavior and merge after normal refreshed review of the current head.

options.title: Keep new drafts ephemeral
options.body: Reject persistence and retain current defaults so each New Session starts without stored UI choices.

options.title: Narrow the remembered fields
options.body: Approve only a smaller set such as workspace/worktree while leaving model and reasoning selection ephemeral.

recommendation.title: Sponsor browser-local persistence
recommendation.body: Accept this per-browser, per-Gateway, per-agent preference behavior and merge after normal refreshed review of the current head.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history connects steipete to the implementation surface and makes them the strongest available routing candidate.
